newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee ends marginally down in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee ends marginally down in dull trade.

text.p: The Indian rupee ended at 35.65/66 per rupee on Monday in dull trade, marginally down from the day's opening quote of 35.64/65, dealers said.
"It was basically a dull day," said a dealer at a private bank. The rupee was traded at a high of 35.63 and a low of 35.66 per dollar, he said.
Forward premia were largely steady on Monday with the premium for six-month dollars closing at an annualised rate of 8.64 percent against the weekend close of 8.75 percent, dealers said.
